message: Hey Jane, how are you doing these days? I remembered when I visited you last time, you are taking care of a lovely girl called Lily. Is she doing well?
Reminder: Staff meeting at 2 PM today in the main hall.
Good morning Jane, just checking in to see if there's anything we need to prepare for Lily's school meeting next week.
Jane, could you please send me the report on the community outreach program?
Jane, I hope you're doing well. I just wanted to ask if you have any updates on Lily. I miss her a lot.
Don't forget to submit your ideas for the upcoming charity event!
Hey, are we still on for lunch tomorrow?
All staff, please update your emergency contact information by the end of this week.
Jane, thank you for your help with the paperwork. Lily is lucky to have you.
Is Lily okay? I heard it's been tough for her. Please let me know if there's anything I can do.
